limitations: Pooled statements (average dialysis vintage of 2.2 years; general melioidosis epidemiology, treatment recommendations and cited cohorts) are not assigned to individual patients.

Abstract states blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei for both patients, whereas body text reports sterile initial blood cultures for Case 1 with positive liver-abscess pus culture; kept as a review_only conflict.

Empirical treatment after the first admission of Case 1 is unspecified; exact transplant dates, onset of Case 2 febrile illness and whether the 3-month cotrimoxazole course was complete are not reported.
Figure 1 caption gives the largest liver abscess size in "cc" (a volume unit); kept verbatim and not converted.
